components.short_description: Top-level summary of current preview readiness and execution authorization state.
components.user_interpretation: Primary answer to whether the chain is preview-only, dry-run-only, pending gate, or blocked.

components.short_description: Lists declared and interpreted capabilities involved in the chain.
components.user_interpretation: Shows what the sleeve/runtime chain says it needs.

components.short_description: Summarizes whether required providers are present and version-valid.
components.user_interpretation: Explains whether a provider chain exists for the declared capabilities.

components.short_description: Shows whether capability-to-tool bindings exist and validate.
components.user_interpretation: Explains whether the chain has a structurally valid provider/tool mapping.

components.short_description: Displays trust tier posture and whether trust blocks the chain.
components.user_interpretation: Explains whether governance trust policy allows the chain to proceed.

components.short_description: Summarizes whether approval is required, present, missing, expired, or revoked.
components.user_interpretation: Explains approval posture without implying runtime permission.

components.short_description: Shows whether rollback policy is valid for the side-effect/risk posture.
components.user_interpretation: Explains whether a risky chain has an acceptable rollback posture.

components.short_description: Shows whether the chain stays within tenant boundaries.
components.user_interpretation: Explains whether tenant rules are satisfied.

components.short_description: Lists stable blocked-reason tokens and human-readable explanations.
components.user_interpretation: Explains why the chain cannot advance.

components.short_description: Shows non-terminal warnings and degraded-state notes.
components.user_interpretation: Explains issues that should be addressed before advancing, but are not terminal blockers.

components.short_description: Displays preserved mismatch notes, sentinels, and known consistency exceptions.
components.user_interpretation: Explains known inconsistencies that are intentionally preserved for validation visibility.

components.short_description: Provides next actions, remediation paths, and escalation recommendations.
components.user_interpretation: Explains what to do next within governance limits.

components.short_description: Shows how current state maps to exportable audit/reporting bundles.
components.user_interpretation: Explains where the current view can be exported for audit or compliance use.
